item.description:
The first release of this fork of Teddy Chan's Ice 2. It installs beside upstream Ice 2 with its own settings, permissions and backups, and updates itself from this repository.

  • Runs on macOS 15 Sequoia as well as macOS 26 and 27.
  • Russian translation (by @shendrykau), and error alerts are translated.
  • Caps Lock no longer stops Ice 2 from moving, clicking and rehiding menu bar items.
  • Moves and clicks no longer hang with the cursor hidden when an app does not respond.
  • Temporarily shown items go back even when the app next to them quit.
  • Quitting no longer writes an empty backup that resets settings when restored; backups live in ~/Documents/Ice 2 Backups.
  • Settings that fail to load are no longer overwritten with the defaults.
  • Remove menu bar background keeps the app menus and status items visible.
  • macOS 27: clicking the clock or another icon no longer shows the Hidden section.

    • Releases are signed with an Apple Development certificate and not notarized: on a Mac other than the one that built it, open it once with System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway.
